name: Microgrid storage dispatch tracking monitor
summary: Compares the assigned storage power target with the measured AC or DC response at its defined boundary.
description: Compares the assigned storage power target with the measured AC or DC response at its defined boundary. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Storage target and measurement” at the input and “Storage power tracking error” at the output. Measurement boundaries must match the target basis.
